preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 30.
The number of vertices N in each test case must be between 1 and 100.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= marker <= 2 for marker in markers)
preconditions.description: Each marker must have an integer value of 0, 1, or 2.
The number of edges must be exactly N-1, forming a tree.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= N and 1 <= v <= N for u, v in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge must connect vertices with valid indices between 1 and N.

postconditions.description: The output must be the minimum unattractiveness for each test case.
